Hon’ble Pankaj Purohit, J.
Mr. Bhagwat Mehra, learned counsel for the 
petitioner.
2. Mr. Devesh Ghildiyal, learned B.H. for the State.
Impleadment Application (IA No.1 of 2026)
3. An impleadment application has been filed by the 
petitioner for impleading Mr. K.S. Rawat – In-Charge 
Director, Elementary Education, Nainital and Mr. Ranjeet 
Singh Negi – Chief Education Officer as respondent￾contemnor nos.3 and 4, in the present contempt petition 
as the earlier incumbents Mr. Ajay Nautiyal has been 
retired and Mr. Govind Ram Jaiswal has been transferred.
4. Learned counsel for the State has no objection if 
impleadment application is allowed as the same is formal 
in nature.
5. Accordingly impleadment application is allowed.
6. Let necessary impleadment be incorporated in the 
contempt petition by supplying amended memo of parties 
within three days.
7. Issue notice to respondent nos.3 and 4 returnable 
within six weeks.
8. Steps to be taken within three days.
9. List this case on 28.09.2026.
10. In the meantime, respondents-contemnors may file  2
response or comply with the order.
 
 (Pankaj Purohit, J.)
 03.08.2026
